title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Solid Brass Hardware Bathroom Storage | Autumn Sparkle | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized, space-saving storage to your bathroom with this wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and solid brass hardware in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. Designed to coordinate within the Carolina Collection, it complements transitional bathroom hardware and works well with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Thick, beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished installation

- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5.54 Inches

- Product size (overall): 16 Inches (L) x 16 Inches (H) x 5.54 Inches (W)
